description: Land Title Settlement Department  - Maagammana, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520004
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property rights without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other non-land related administrative matters.
